## Governing Overview

[mcp/tests overview](../../../../overview.md)

## Purpose

Lockfile for the Rust repository-profile fixture at format version 3, generated by Cargo,
listing only the `repository-profile-rust-fixture` package. It makes `cargo test --locked`
meaningful for the fixture repository (the fixture suite scripts all pass `--locked`).

## Code Commentary

Auto-generated header plus the single package record (name/version). The [[package]] entry
matches `Cargo.toml`; no external crates are locked because the fixture has no dependencies.

## Invariants And Boundaries

- Auto-generated; do not hand-edit. Must stay consistent with `Cargo.toml`.
- Fixture data only.

## Docs References

CCR-R22@v1 requires profiles to declare runtime/toolchain/image/lock identities per rail.

Each declared rail carries runtime/toolchain/image/lock identities.

The governing CCR-R22@v1 packet is a task artifact, so this requirement fact is
recorded as prose here (task artifact paths are not repo-relative citations).
